title: AI-assisted songs storm Korean music charts
source_used: The Korea Times (full text, adapted from Xportsnews)
key_facts: 'Have You Become the Adult You Dreamed of?' by Meomuru ranked No. 3 on Melon's TOP100 as of Wednesday (14 Oct 2026) and No. 2 on Genie Music and YouTube Music.
The song was released in June and was in the top 20 of Melon's TOP100 as recently as early October before climbing.
Meomuru used the generative AI music platform Suno for the vocals, wrote the lyrics and directed the production.
Many listeners discover only afterwards that the vocals were AI-generated.
'GG EZ' by M. Sasuke (released in May) spread through TikTok, Reels and Shorts, with K-pop idols joining challenges.
The report says debate is growing over displacement of human singers, training data, creators' rights and credit; voice-imitating AI covers raise voice and publicity rights issues.
The article is credited to Xportsnews, adapted by a generative AI system and edited by The Korea Times.
quote_evidence: Meomuru used Suno, a generative AI music platform, for the song’s vocals.
Meomuru wrote the lyrics and oversaw the concept and overall production direction, using AI as a tool to bring the musical vision to life.
Nevertheless, public listening habits are evolving faster than the rules governing the industry.
why_it_matters_hint: An AI-vocal song is competing on the same top charts as human artists in South Korea.
notes: Single outlet; chart positions as of one day.
